# Managing the reader Q&A

The contact page embeds https://www.askbox.buzz/ask/mileena-rayne.
Questions and published answers are managed in Askbox, not in website files.

1. Sign in to Askbox and open Inbox.
2. Choose a question to answer. Respect any private-answer request.
3. Review the question for identifying information and spoilers before choosing
   to make the answer public. Do not promise anonymity for named submissions.
4. Public answers display through the embedded Askbox page without rebuilding
   the website. Unanswered questions should remain hidden.

Settings verified on September 29, 2026:
- Public Q&A: on
- Include Unanswered: off
- Allow Comments: off
- Who can ask: anyone (anonymous or nickname)

The embed is the full public page, not an official custom widget. Keep the
Open my Askbox link as a fallback for browser or service restrictions.

`_data/reader_qa.yml` contains only the editorial quick answers above the embed.
Never copy private Askbox submissions, names, or emails into this public repo.

Private contact messages continue to use the existing Google Form. Its native
confirmation opens in a new tab; there is no timer-based success message.
The Google Form's speaking category is spelled `Speaking / Worshop Inquiry`;
the submitted option value intentionally matches the source form.
